messages:
jamie: Quick sync — release tomorrow 10:00 PT. Final deploy sequence + handoffs. Who's on deploy? Need smoke owners + rollback ready by 9:50. Also need CS/marketing comms final.
li: I'll be primary deploy. Plan: canary @10:00, 10% for 5m, then 100% at 10:10 if ok.
rohit: I'll run canary smoke tests and latency checks. Which metrics threshold for auto-abort?
jamie: Abort if p95 token latency > 800ms or error rate > 0.5% for 5m. Manual abort if anything obvious. li pls have rollback ready.
li: Copy. Rollback command ready: `infra promote --from=canary --to=stable --tag=prev-release-2026-03-18`. I'll paste exact ops steps in runbook.
nina: Preflight done: config flags set, no DB migrations. I'm owner for smoke checklist. Will run these steps at 9:55:
- sanity /health
- small prompt smoke (chat)
- embedding lookup test
rohit: For smoke tests, I'll run this script:
```bash
./scripts/smoke-canary.sh --target canary
```
will post results.
sam: Marketing final assets ready. CS draft ready. We'll send customer email at 10:30 PT if no issues. @nina can you confirm feature note for in-app banner?
nina: Confirmed. Banner copy: "New faster inference + reduced cost per token — see release notes." I put full copy in the docs.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job created: job_id=rel-1963456789, start=2026-03-18T17:00:00Z
jamie: Good. Quick release notes snippet for CS/marketing to use:
```
- Reduced median generation latency by ~25% for common chat models.
- New adaptive batching enabled for small prompts.
- Minor API: added `response.trace_id` header for troubleshooting.
```
sam: Perfect. I'll use that in the email + CS playbook. Support rotation: who's on first line for 10:00-11:00?
rohit: I'm on pager for 10:00-10:30, then alex for 10:30-11:00.
jamie: Rollback procedure summary (li will run): 1) pause traffic, 2) promote prev tag, 3) clear KV cache. li pls confirm steps live in runbook and you can execute in <5 min.
li: Confirmed. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-rel-1963456789 (I'll be at the keyboard)
nina: I'll post smoke results in this thread by 9:58. If green, say :white_check_mark: 
rohit: If I hit any error >0.5% I'll ping #incidents and start abort checklist.
jamie: Great. Last ask — everyone ack here when you have environment access and credentials ready.
sam: ack
li: ack
nina: ack
rohit: ack
deploy-bot: Job status: awaiting start. react :rocket:
